pages.text: Place it next to a warehouse: it pushes items/fluid/energy into it.$(br2)Teal arrows pointing inward; right-click to pick the target (shared or a private warehouse).

The warehouse is $(l)infinite on two levels$(/l):$(br2)- a single slot can hold up to 100 million (no 64 limit)$(br2)- each page holds 54 slots; a new page is created automatically when full$(br2)$(br2)The real stack amount is stored separately, so it survives restarts. Empty pages are dropped on save.
Note: at most 99 items are taken out at a time (the rest stays in the slot). That keeps over-limit stacks from leaking into inventories or dropped items, which would crash the game on save.
